text:
jen: Heads up — CI is failing on the release branch after a regen. Diff looks tiny but it flipped property ordering in generated types, which is forcing a minor semver bump in the JS SDK :/

omar: ugh. link to failing job: <https://ci.internal/redwood/1234/build>. ci-bot log shows `typegen` step produced diffs.

ci-bot: @channel build 1234 failed in step `typegen-regenerate` — see artifacts: <https://ci.internal/artifacts/1234/typegen-diff.txt> :x:

mia: can someone paste the diff? i can't access CI from home network right now.

jen: pasted snippet below:
```diff
-  // properties sorted alphabetically
-  name?: string;
-  age?: number;
+  // original order preserved by openapi schema order
+  age?: number;
+  name?: string;
```

sam: hmm that ordering change shouldn't be semver-major but it is changing generated types (order matters for some equality tests in sample apps). tests fail in samplekit on `expect(generated).toMatchInlineSnapshot()`

omar: this smells like nondeterministic openapi->typegen sorting. Could be a dependency bump (openapi-parser or our stable-sort change).

lucy: i ran `yarn regen` locally against the same commit and didn't get diffs. so it's environment-dependent. maybe node version or `prettier` config?

jen: good catch. CI image uses node 18.14, my laptop is 20.1. But why would prettier reorder types?

sam: propose bisecting the toolchain: run regen in docker with CI image, then swap one dep at a time (prettier, openapi-typescript, typegen-cli).

omar: i'll try a quick repro in a container. commands i used:
```bash
docker run --rm -it -v "$PWD":/repo -w /repo node:18.14-bullseye bash -c "yarn; yarn regen --ci"
```

jen: thanks. if we confirm it's openapi-typescript 6.2.x vs 6.1.x we can pin and patch release flow to avoid accidental semver bumps. Also need to decide whether changelog automation should treat regen-only nondet diffs as SKIP.

sam: release-bot currently labels PRs with `semver: patch|minor` based on package.json changes and `regendiff` scanner. We could add a filter to treat reorders-only as no-change. risky though.

lucy: alternative: keep scanner strict but add a CI job that runs `regen --ci` and fails the build if regen diffs are present — that already exists but it's flaky. we should make it deterministic first.

omar: update: reproduced locally in docker — looks like `openapi-parser` sorts object keys differently when source schema has `additionalProperties: true` plus `x-order` missing. filing a quick PR to pin parser to 1.9.2 for the release branch.

jen: thanks. once PR is up, can we run the full sampleapp CI to ensure snapshot tests pass?

ci-bot: created artifact for reproducer: <https://ci.internal/artifacts/1234/reproducer.tar.gz>. triggered job 1235 for PR #2412. :gear:

sam: if this fixes it, we should update docs in devex about regen variance and add a short checklist in release playbook: 1) run regen in CI image, 2) verify sampleapp snapshots, 3) explicit semver justification in PR body.

jen: agreed. i'll add a PR checklist item and a short blurb in the changelog automation README. also pinging @eng-ml later to discuss long-term fix (stable sort in typegen). :+1:

omar: PR #2412 is up (https://github.com/redwood-inference/typegen/pull/2412) — please review.

lucy: reviewed +1. let's wait for CI on the branch and then revert the temporary pin if upstream fixes. :eyes:

jen: awesome. thanks all. i'll watch the release window tomorrow. :shipit:
